import copy, json
from work import evaluate

def check(req, pol, exp):
    req0, pol0 = copy.deepcopy(req), copy.deepcopy(pol)
    got = evaluate(req, pol)
    assert got == exp, (got, exp)
    assert req == req0 and pol == pol0
